sentences: My brother plays football every Friday.
أخي يلعب كرة القدم كل جمعة.
Does she speak English? — Yes, she does.
I usually walk in the evening.
I sometimes visit my friends at the weekend.
أحيانًا أزور أصدقائي في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.
What do you do in your free time?
How often do you go to the gym?
I go shopping once a week.

grammar.intro_en:
Add -es after ch, sh, s, x, o (watches, washes, goes, does). Consonant + y → ies (study → studies), but vowel + y → s (play → plays).
Frequency words go before the main verb (I usually walk) but after am / is / are (He is never late).
grammar.intro_ar: بعد doesn't أو Does يرجع الفعل لأصله بدون s: He doesn't work (وليس doesn't works).

write_speak:
Write & Speak — Write 6 sentences about the day of a friend or family member (use he / she).
Example: My friend Tamer is an engineer. He gets up at six. He always drinks coffee in the morning. He drives to work. He doesn't work on Friday. He plays football twice a week.
